The Yatra Company

The Yatra Company is a Lucknow-based taxi and cab service providing airport transfers, local taxi services, outstation trips, corporate travel, and other pre-booked transportation services across Lucknow and Uttar Pradesh.

Core Information

* Business Name: The Yatra Company
* Business Type: Taxi and cab service
* Location: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India
* Address: T9-1103, Sun Breeze 1, Faizabad Road, BBD Green City, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226028
* Phone: +91 91988 93198
* Booking: Phone and WhatsApp
* Service Area: Lucknow and destinations across Uttar Pradesh and nearby cities
* Services: Airport transfers, local taxi service, outstation taxi service, corporate travel, wedding transportation, pilgrimage travel, and intercity cab services
* Vehicle Types: Sedan, SUV, Innova/Crysta and other vehicles depending on availability

Booking

Customers can contact The Yatra Company by phone or WhatsApp to enquire about availability, fares, pickup and drop locations, travel dates, and vehicle options.

Phone: +91 91988 93198
